mods.config_blocked: The configuration was not applied — it would damage the server.
mods.change_failed_rolled_back: Mod change failed: {{error}}. The previous configuration is running again.
mods.change_failed_rolled_back_history_o: Mod change failed: {{error}}. The previous configuration is running again. (The history entry could not be closed and therefore still shows as running.)
mods.quarantine_world_operation_running: This server already has an operation running: {{operation}} — please wait. Touching the quarantine in the meantime hits exactly the world that operation is rebuilding.
mods.world_operation_running_wait: This server already has an operation running: {{operation}} — please wait.
mods.ini_unreadable_nothing_applied: The server configuration (.ini) cannot be read ({{error}}) — which mods are running is therefore unknown. Nothing is applied.
mods.draft_unchanged: The draft already matches the running server.
mods.server_still_running: The server is still running — nothing was changed. A mod change over the running world would damage it.
mods.change_failed_rollback_incomplete: Mod change failed: {{error}}. WARNING: rollback incomplete — please check manually.
mods.change_failed_rollback_incomplete_h: Mod change failed: {{error}}. WARNING: rollback incomplete — please check manually. (The history entry could not be closed and therefore still shows as running.)
mods.quarantine_server_running: The server is running — stop it first. Restoring over the running world would damage it.
mods.world_reset_unconfirmed: While shutting down, the server wrote terrain for the maps being dropped: {{count}} world files would have to be reset. The preflight could not see that beforehand. Nothing was changed — please apply the change again with the world reset confirmed.
mods.quarantine_manifest_unreadable: The quarantine “{{name}}” has no readable manifest ({{error}}). Without the manifest it is unknown which files belong where — so nothing is touched. The folder is at `data/quarantine/{{name}}`.
mods.list_blocked: The list was not applied — it would damage the server.
mods.world_operation_running: This server already has an operation running: {{operation}}.
mods.list_unchanged: The list already matches the running server.
mods.modconfig_write_failed_stays_stoppe: modconfig.lua could not be written ({{error}}). Nothing was changed. The server was stopped before and stays stopped.
mods.modconfig_write_failed_running_agai: modconfig.lua could not be written ({{error}}). Nothing was changed. The server is running again.
mods.modconfig_write_failed_server_down: modconfig.lua could not be written ({{error}}). Nothing was changed. WARNING: the server did NOT come back up.
mods.selection_blocked: The selection was not applied — it would damage the server.
mods.selection_unchanged: The selection already matches the running server.
mods.files_not_moved: These mod files could not be moved: {{files}}. The selection was NOT applied completely.{{rollback}}
mods.folder_unreadable: The mod folder cannot be read ({{error}}) — nothing was touched.
mods.ini_unreadable_reset_refused: The server configuration (.ini) cannot be read ({{error}}) — a reset would empty the draft instead of bringing it to the running state.
mods.history_not_written: The change is applied and the server is running — only the history could not be written ({{error}}). The entry therefore still shows as running.
mods.avorion_entered_no_boot_proof: {{mods}} mod(s) entered — server was stopped, no boot proof
